Tana:

Carol
Enron
EB 3803
713-853-4821 (ph)
713-646-3101 (fx)

-----Original Message-----
From: Sara
To: Carol
Date: Thu, 20 Apr 2000 18:07
Subject: Enron Online - Enserco Energy

Carol:

Enserco was busted on line today. We are collateralized w/ L/Cs but exposure is increasing w/ online volume. Sent an ISDA draft weeks ago — no response. I spoke to Don Perkins (Enserco Credit Mgr) and told him no additional volume w/o an executed ISDA.

At this point I feel we should not take on any further transactions until the ISDA is signed. Please let me know your thoughts. Also pls forward to the appropriate Enron Online personnel so they are aware of Enserco's status.

Thanks.
Sara
Enron Corp.
1400 Smith Street, EB 3801a
Houston, Texas 77002
713-853-5620 (phone)
713-646-3490 (fax)

Let me know what else you need.

if we want to move forward now, first step is to get someone in Credit to generate updated credit terms for whatever new notional we're looking at — the underlying approval work doesn't need to be redone, just the terms refreshed. existing bookings tied to that master aren't at risk; no unwind needed.

Mark

let me know how you want to handle this — happy to get on a call.
